verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing multi-channel support: Shopify claims you can 'sell online, in person, and in AI chats', it consolidates 'orders from all your sales channels in one place', and its Global Catalog exposes merchant products to AI agents across the ecosystem. Nothing documents listing or syncing a catalog to marketplaces, social commerce platforms or shopping feeds, and the Markets material covers geographic markets rather than external channels. Missing for 10: documented marketplace listing/sync, social commerce channel integration, shopping-feed generation, single-catalog sync mechanics, independent corroboration.
